headlines.title: Should First All Inclusive Resort Require Action From Marriott (MAR) Investors?
headlines.summary: JW Marriott opened its first all-inclusive resort in Costa Rica at Costa Elena, a 415 room beachfront property with wellness, family, and events programming. Marriott International also signed a seven hotel, 1,262 room agreement with FICO Corporation in Thailand. These moves broaden Marriott International's fee generating room base across luxury all inclusive and new midscale concepts.

headlines.title: Marriott International (MAR) Opens First JW Marriott All Inclusive As Valuation Stays In Focus
headlines.summary: Marriott International (MAR) just crossed a new milestone, with its JW Marriott brand opening Costa Elena Resort & Spa in Costa Rica as its first all-inclusive property and expanding the group’s high-end resort footprint. headlines.title: How Marriott’s All‑Inclusive and Midscale Push Could Reshape the Story for Marriott (MAR) Investors
headlines.summary: Marriott International recently opened the JW Marriott Costa Elena Resort & Spa in Costa Rica as the brand’s first-ever all-inclusive property, while also debuting its City Express by Marriott midscale brand in India and signing new hotel agreements in Thailand.

headlines.title: Marriott (MAR) Stock May Be Fully Priced Following Thailand Hotel Expansion
headlines.summary: Marriott International has rewarded shareholders with a strong run in recent years, which naturally raises a tougher question about the price on the screen today. With that kind of share performance, you need to ask whether the current tag is still grounded in what the hotel group is actually earning. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 153.0%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that Marriott's earnings story can keep justifying this kind of compounding.

headlines.title: Marriott, Hilton Stocks Get Buy Ratings as Lodging Sector Enters New Era
headlines.summary: Marriott has been a standout among the leading hotel stocks. It has a huge loyalty ecosystem.

description: Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation, franchising, and licensing of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Greater China, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. The company operates properties under the JW Marriott, The Ritz-Carlton, The Luxury Collection, W Hotels, St. Regis, EDITION, Bvlgari, Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Autograph Collection, Renaissance Hotels, Le Méridien, Delta Hotels by Marriott, MGM Collection with Marriott Bonvoy, Tribute Portfolio, Gaylord Hotels, Design Hotels, Marriott Executive Apartments, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, Courtyard by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott, Residence Inn by Marriott, SpringHill Suites by Marriott, Four Points by Sheraton, TownePlace Suites by Marriott, Aloft Hotels, AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, Element Hotels, Protea Hotels by Marriott, citizenM, City Express by Marriott, and Four Points Flex by Sheraton brands. It also operates residences, timeshares, and yachts. The company was formerly known as New Marriott MI, Inc. and changed its name to Marriott International, Inc. in May 1998. Marriott International, Inc. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland.
